field_principles.efficiency_delta_vs_predictor_only: difference in min(human/agent,1)^2 efficiency versus predictor-only, never inferred from mismatched candidate groups.
field_principles.energy_augmented_solve_rate: held-out solve-rate for the same cached candidates ranked by P(frame_change) * (-delta_E).
field_principles.energy_term_added_value: bare bool indicating whether the energy term improved solve-rate or efficiency without reducing solve-rate.
field_principles.honest_verdict: MUST start with terminal prefix complete:/complete_/success:/success_/passed:/passed_/shipped:/shipped_ (Verdict Terminal-Prefix Discipline).
field_principles.inference_substrate: explicit verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates declaration so adversarial_verify applies the cached-candidate duration floor.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: records WHICH resources were verified; pre-empts silent-missing-resource fabrication.
field_principles.predictor_only_solve_rate: held-out solve-rate for the same cached candidates ranked by P(frame_change) alone.
